Histograms

Source: R/plots.R
cr_plot_hist.Rd

A histogram with a dashed line at the mean; with by, one panel per group in the package palette (or overlaid).

Usage

cr_plot_hist(
  data,
  var,
  by = NULL,
  layout = c("facet", "overlay"),
  bins = 30,
  binwidth = NULL,
  mean_line = TRUE,
  palette = NULL,
  style = "nature",
  labels = NULL,
  level_labels = NULL
)

Arguments

data

A data frame.

var

Variable to plot.

by

Optional grouping variable.

layout

With by: "facet" (one panel per group) or "overlay".

bins, binwidth

Passed to ggplot2::geom_histogram().

mean_line

Draw the mean as a dashed line.

palette

Palette name or colors.

style

Theme style passed to theme_cr().

labels, level_labels

Display labels.

Value

A ggplot object.
